title: Basilique Rigatoni Bake
description: A simple yet flavorful pasta bake featuring basilique, rigatoni, and a hint of floral notes.

ingredients.name: floral
ingredients.notes: dried edible flowers or floral extract

instructions: Cook the rigatoni according to package directions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the chopped basilique and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes until wilted.
Stir in the dried floral and season with salt and pepper to taste.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked rigatoni, basilique mixture, and grated mozzarella.
Transfer the rigatoni mixture to a baking dish and top with additional mozzarella if desired.
Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
